editorial: Your quiet night at home is suddenly a thriller when the lines between fiction and reality blur. In Argylle, a sci‑fi espionage hybrid, you follow Elly Conway as her cat Alfie brings more plot twists than the cat itself. Joaquin Phoenix carries every scene with almost no dialogue, turning his internal monologues into a tense, silent dialogue of his mind. The film uses long, handheld takes that shift from domestic to covert thriller in a single pan, keeping you on edge. Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling, Argylle throws you into a labyrinth where the cat walks between worlds.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
